items.reason: One server-enforced source of truth for role, plan, profession, overrides and every access decision.
Professionals expect saved filters, columns, properties and team-standard templates.
Fast keyboard access to properties, markers, reports, tools and actions.
Surface material property, source, deadline and report changes without making users recheck everything.
Every value should expose source, retrieved date, transform, confidence and version.
Organization roles, shared folders, comments, assignments and client-safe sharing are core professional SaaS needs.
Turn selected markers into branded attorney, lender, agent and investor deliverables.
Professionals need to know who changed a property, view, note or export and recover mistakes.
Search properties, towns, owners, block/lot, markers and source documents from one place.
Role-aware setup, sample reports and progressive disclosure shorten time to first value.
Large exports, portfolio refreshes and report generation need progress, retry and completion states.
Pro+ and Teams users will expect controlled movement into CRMs, LOS, case and transaction systems.
Make plan limits, credits, renewals, invoices and overages transparent.
Capture the page, property, marker and diagnostics with every support request.
Expose source outages, delayed refreshes, incidents and expected recovery with subscriptions.
